article.title: UAW Statement on Veterans Day
article.author: Justin Mayhugh
article.content: The UAW extends our deepest gratitude to every veteran who has served our nation. This Veterans Day, we honor your service, recognize your sacrifices, and thank you for answering a call that asked so much of you and your families. To veterans of every branch and generation, whether you served at home or overseas, in times of war or peace: your service matters. We recognize the time spent away from loved ones, the demands of military life, and the sacrifices that do not always receive public recognition. Our thanks extend to the families and loved ones who stood beside you throughout your service and beyond. To the veterans within our UAW family, our members, retirees, and their loved ones—thank you for being part of our union. The spirit of looking out for one another is at the heart of solidarity. Today, we reaffirm that veterans belong in that circle of care, respect, and support. Honoring veterans must extend beyond a single day. It means listening to your experiences, respecting the different paths you have traveled, and standing beside you as neighbors, coworkers, and friends. I encourage our UAW family to take a moment to thank a veteran, reach out to someone who served, and carry that appreciation into the days ahead. To all veterans: thank you for your service, your sacrifice, and the example of commitment you have given us. On Veterans Day and throughout the year, please know that you have our gratitude and our respect.
